pages.title: Off the Ghast Menu
pages.text: Use equipment that changes a particular encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The Pendant changes Ghast hostility according to its native description. Use its supported chest or accessory slot; merely carrying it is insufficient.

pages.title: Wear a ghast pendant
pages.text: Wear the Pendant in a supported chest or accessory slot. Its tooltip concerns Ghast hostility, not every Nether creature.
